title: Efficient nonviral integration of large transgenes into human T cells using Cas9-CLIPT
authors: Anna Tommasi, Dan Cappabianca, Madison Bugel, Kirstan Gimse, Karl Lund-Peterson, Hum Shrestha, Denis Arutyunov, James A. Williams, Seshidhar Reddy Police, Venkata Indurthi, Sage Z. Davis, Muhammed Murtaza, Christian M. Capitini, Krishanu Saha
relevance_to_cellguide: Background/context for RNP-based primary T-cell engineering methodology (Cas9 RNP + template delivery for CAR-T manufacturing) — same delivery modality (RNP electroporation) as Ito et al.'s T-cell dataset. Lower priority: focused on knock-in/HDR engineering, not on the guide-ranking/indel-efficiency question central to the plan.
